Battle for Dream Island (abbreviated as BFDI) is an American animated web series created by twin brothers Cary and Michael Huang. The first episode was uploaded to YouTube on January 1, 2010. }}, the ongoing series consists of 6 seasons and 112 episodes (released in 117 parts) overall.

| ShortSummary    = On the fictional continent of Goiky, twenty anthropomorphic objects are interacting with each other in a grassland. A dark gray speaker box called the Announcer descends from the sky and announces the existence of Dream Island, an island designed to be the ultimate paradise, and that whoever owns the island can decide who is allowed onto it. He starts a contest for the island with the twenty objects as contestants.
The first challenge is to see who can stay on a balance beam the longest. Two of the objects, Pin and Leafy, win the first contest and get to organize the teams of the competition; the Squishy Cherries and the Squashy Grapes. The next contest is a race to make a boat and row it to the finish line across the Goiky Canal, which the Squishy Cherries win.
| LineColor       = 359CF1

| ShortSummary    = Because Pin won the challenge for her team, she obtains a "Win Token", which allows her to halve her votes during the elimination ceremony, called Cake at Stake. Said ceremony is attended by the losing team's members. They get cake slices until there are none left, revealing the eliminated contestant, who will be treated with a vaguely described "TLC". The cake for Cake at Stake is a strawberry cake (Also known as a "Regular cake"). Flower is eliminated with 4 votes, and though she attempts to murder the Announcer with an "Announcer crusher", the crusher explodes and she is sent away. The contest is an obstacle course, won by the Squashy Grapes. Needle obtains a Win Token for finishing the challenge first.

| ShortSummary    = The cake for Cake at Stake is cupcakes, and Pin is eliminated with 5 votes. The teams are temporarily split into five teams of three, and the contest is to get across three islands.
On island 1, the contestants are tasked with looking through safes to find rafts and paddles. Island 2 has ten keys hanging from poles, which are used to unlock a locked building on island 3. However, five of the keys are fake, forcing their holders to go back to island 2 and get another key. Coiny, Ice Cube, and Needle lose the contest, and Eraser, Firey, and Pen all get Win Tokens for finishing first.

Therefore, the Announcer decides that the winners get to take a contestant from the losing team, with no one getting eliminated. The contest is to solve a jigsaw puzzle, won by the Squashy Grapes. | ShortSummary    = The contest is a race where each contestant has to carry one of their other team members, except for the last contestant, who does not carry anyone. | LineColor       = 359CF1

| ShortSummary    = Beginning with this episode, the show would feature fan-made recommended characters from viewers, with Bomby being the first under this title.

| ShortSummary    = The eliminated contestants plot their escape from the TLC, but the Announcer appears and tells them to stop planning. | ShortSummary    = Firey and Leafy hang out in the former's ferris wheel. However, Firey installed a lava fall on it. Unable to escape, Leafy is burned to death. She does not get recovered for Cake at Stake, as the Announcer sold the recovery centers due to "budget cuts". Firey does not believe him, so he bets his life savings. Announcer accepts the bet and tells Firey that the recovery centers really were sold.
Announcer abruptly cancels the show after seeing that they once again received a fewer vote total than the last few episodes. Flower throws a nest of bug eggs at the Announcer in anger, causing bugs to overwhelmingly infest the area, and everyone runs from the quickly-spreading swarm, attempting to save themselves. None of the contestants survive: Firey, the TLC prisoners, and all the recommended characters are devoured by the bugs, Flower gets hit by a meteor and falls into a canyon, and the Announcer pops Bubble when she finds out he made the bugs. The Announcer eventually reaches a button that deletes the bug swarm, and notices that David survived because he is immune to them. The Announcer continues the competition with clones of David posing as contestants and recommended characters. The Cake at Stake is red velvet cake, and Flower is eliminated with 524 votes. At that point, the contestants suddenly come back, all having faked their deaths. There is no contest, so the Announcer invites the viewers to vote who should win Dream Island. In addition, the Announcer promises that a second season will only happen if they receive 1,000 votes.
In the stinger, it is revealed that the Announcer bought new recovery centers for the final 3 and himself with Firey's life savings.

| ShortSummary    = After releasing the eliminated contestants, the Announcer holds the final Cake at Stake for Bubble, Leafy and Firey. There were only 870 votes, which supposedly meant no Season 2 would occur. The cake is a Grand Cake, made up of all the previous cakes. Before the Announcer can declare the winner, Flower damages him, affecting his speech. The eliminated contestants have an opinion vote for which contestant in the finale they would like to win Dream Island. With 406 out of 870 votes, Firey wins the cake and Dream Island.
When choosing who gets to enter, Firey lets everyone in except for runner-up Leafy, who he excludes because he was hurt by her wanting to get off his ferris wheel. Angered, Leafy buys Dream Island from the Announcer, using a box of paper slips to give him a large sum of money to fully recover the speaker boxes' budget. When the other contestants find Dream Island suddenly missing, they head outside to search for it, while Tennis Ball, Match, Snowball and Woody are beamed up by the Announcer's UFO. After Bubble calls out Flower for her behavior, the latter destroys the recovery centers in a fit of rage and pops the former. She is in turn crushed to death by the UFO. It is also revealed that Woody died from fear of the UFO's gray color. The other speaker boxes thank Announcer for recovering their lost funds and they all leave on the UFO back to their home planet. When the contestants find out about Leafy stealing Dream Island, they threaten to kill her via Flower's announcer crusher. Before she is crushed, Firey swoops in using a hang glider and saves her, telling her that he values their friendship more than the island, as they fly away towards the sunset.
| LineColor       = 359CF1

| ShortSummary    = Woody flees with the show's prize, overheating the mech suit by stuffing it with sand to create a glass bridge. Everyone becomes the host, and Coiny, still trapped in the Earth with Pin's corpse, is eliminated at Cake at Stake. The contest is to get to the end of the bridge and step on what's left of Dream Island Again, doing challenges based on the season's previous contests along the way. Each challenge is optional, though advantages will be given to those who complete them by each challenge's respective eliminated contestant (Donut for the first challenge, Dora for the second, and so on). Book, Needle and Tennis Ball continually alternate between who is in the lead, culminating in a standoff between Woody and the three contestants at the end of the bridge. Woody inadvertently falls off, and Coiny, who is returned to the surface after Nickel unintentionally uses a Swap Token to switch positions, uses Pin's drill to break the bridge while attempting to attack Book, believing she "killed" Pin with her flag, sending the contestants and Dream Island Again falling back to the ground. Ultimately, Book becomes the final contestant to earn immunity (as well as her first victory overall), leaving Tennis Ball and Needle up for elimination.
Note: Clay O'Donnell, Rosie O'Donnell, and TomSka reprise their guest roles.

| ShortSummary    = Leafy tries to cover up her theft of Dream Island to Flower and Bubble. Meanwhile, the remaining contestants see that everyone else is unwilling to host Cake at Stake again, so they decide to do so themselves. However, they do not know how to set up the ceremony, so they use the "Florilegium Annals: Recording The Strange" book as a guide. Needle bakes the cake (bringing almost all of the eliminated contestants with her), Book records the votes, and Tennis Ball designs a place for the ceremony. Leafy attempts to assist Tennis Ball. Needle is bought to FreeSmart's personal kitchen to bake the cake, and the eliminated contestants decide to help her.
